stem.text: A stone is projected horizontally at time $t = 0$ and falls. Air resistance is negligible. The stone has a horizontal component of velocity $v_\text{H}$ and a vertical component of velocity $v_\text{V}$.
Which graph shows how $v_\text{H}$ and $v_\text{V}$ vary with time $t$?

A.alt: Graph of velocity against t. A horizontal line labelled vH and a straight rising line labelled vV.

B.alt: Graph of velocity against t. A horizontal line labelled vV and a straight rising line labelled vH.

C.alt: Graph of velocity against t. A horizontal line labelled vH and a curved line labelled vV rising from the origin.

D.alt: Graph of velocity against t. A horizontal line labelled vH and a curved line labelled vV falling from the vertical axis.
